author: 3snX
content: Result: M11 worldbuilding browser UI complete. 12 files, 1824 lines added across 8 commits. Components: WorldbuildingBrowser (tabbed container), HistoryTimeline (scrub + 3 filter types), PolityBrowser (tier/capital/territory/conflicts), ReligionInspector (pantheon/rituals/holy sites/syncretism), CultureInspector (feature vector bars/language/economic base), SettlementDetail (score components + etymology trace via sound-change history). All cross-linked via navigateTo* actions. 21 new tests (13 store + 8 etymology), 441 total passing. tsc clean.
